instruction: Navigate to the contact us page to find customer service information.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the contact us page on premier.ticketek.com.au. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL contains the 'contact' pattern using regex matching. This is a similar navigation task to the original but targets the contact information section.
metadata.verification: Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric with active_tab_info getter. The expected pattern 'contact' should match URLs like '/contact-us' or '/help/contact' on the Ticketek website.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: active_tab_info extracts the active tab URL via accessibility tree and Playwright, which is the right state for verifying navigation
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match performs regex search for 'contact' pattern in the URL, which correctly verifies navigation to contact page
Coverage is complete: Instruction requires navigating to contact page, evaluator checks URL contains 'contact' pattern - this is the appropriate way to verify the navigation task
Expected value is semantically correct: Pattern 'contact' will match typical contact page URLs like '/contact-us', '/contact', '/help/contact' on the Ticketek website
Practical feasibility confirmed: Both getter (accessibility tree + Playwright) and metric (regex matching) will work correctly at runtime
